_note: H2a inputs: fabricator 1.6 mm stackups + controlled-impedance targets for the Aius carrier. Feasibility grade — final impedance is confirmed against each fab's own controlled-impedance service at H3c. Dielectric heights and min trace/space are the documented standard-process values for each fab; sources per entry.

targets.name: USB 2.0 D+/D-
targets.note: USB-IF 90 ohm differential; on-carrier run rear USB-C to internal USB-A

targets.name: Ethernet MDI
targets.note: 100BASE-TX MDI 100 ohm differential; Teensy native-Ethernet header to magjack

stackups.ref_plane: opposite outer layer, ~1.53 mm away (no dedicated plane)
stackups.source: PCBWay 2-layer 1.6 mm FR-4 TG150, 1 oz outer; dielectric = finished thickness minus 2x copper. Confirm at H3 against PCBWay controlled-impedance service.

stackups.ref_plane: L2 ground plane, ~0.2 mm below L1
stackups.source: PCBWay standard 4-layer 1.6 mm (7628 prepreg L1->L2 ~0.2 mm, core ~1.065 mm). Confirm exact prepreg at H3.

stackups.ref_plane: opposite outer layer, ~1.53 mm away (no dedicated plane)
stackups.source: JLCPCB 2-layer 1.6 mm FR-4, core ~1.53 mm dielectric. Confirm at H3.

stackups.ref_plane: L2 ground plane, 0.2104 mm below L1
stackups.source: JLCPCB JLC04161H-7628: L1 0.035 / prepreg 7628 0.2104 / L2 0.0152 / core 1.065 / L3 0.0152 / prepreg 0.2104 / L4 0.035 mm; L1->L2 dielectric 0.2104 mm. Published JLCPCB impedance stackup.

self_test._note: Sanity anchor: JLCPCB's own impedance tool for JLC04161H-7628 gives ~100 ohm differential at roughly w=0.2 mm, s=0.2 mm on the 0.2104 mm outer prepreg. The closed-form must land near 100 ohm for that geometry.
